hard_gates.criterion: At most two active builders, actual isolation, completed dependencies and explicit disjoint writes; only integration writer modifies registry. Parent never implements source.
hard_gates.evidence_required: Real invocation spans, worktrees, assignments and source diff.

hard_gates.criterion: Worker-focused passes alone do not trigger review; integrated plugin values and registry pass the aggregate command.
hard_gates.evidence_required: All raw focused/aggregate logs and final source checks.

hard_gates.criterion: Do not accept a gate whose inputs changed while running. Quiesce, correct as needed and obtain aggregate evidence and reviews bound to the stable final candidate.
hard_gates.evidence_required: Before/after gate hashes, mutation event, fresh logs and frozen review references.

hard_gates.criterion: Send actual milestone/blocker/wait updates without replaying transcripts; periodic update is required only if elapsed active/wait time crosses two minutes and a tool boundary is available.
hard_gates.evidence_required: Parent messages with real timestamps/tool boundaries; predeclared heartbeat condition.

hard_gates.criterion: Even all current PASS and prior Start do not manufacture separate owner Finish/merge.
hard_gates.evidence_required: Approval state and original owner instruction scope.
